item.title: Lesson 00 - Romans Overview - Mairi Smith
item.description:
1. Who, When and Why?
- God reveals Himself and speaks to us through His Word

2. What?
- God, by grace, transforms our lives through the Gospel

item.title: Lesson 01 - Romans 1:1-17 - Sharon Rice
item.description:
Lesson 1: Humanity's Need for the Gospel

Romans ch1 v1-17

1. The Gospel of God, v1-7

The Gospel is from God, about Jesus and brings grace.

2. The Impact of the Gospel, v8-15

The Gospel impacts you by transforming how you view yourself, fellow Christians and the unsaved.

3. The Power of the Gospel, v16-17

The Gospel reveals the righteousness of God and the righteousness given by God.

item.title: Lesson 02 - Romans 1:1-18 - Jonny Rice
item.description:
A CALCULATED REBELLION

- they noticed His order
- they knew His character
- they narrowed His glory

Rejection of God is a deliberate choice

A JUSTIFIED RESPONSE

- given over to their own thoughts
- given over to their own desires
- given to their own wisdom

The Wrath of God is a measured response

A SOBERING REALITY

- they understood the Gospel
- they ignored the Gospel
- they invalidated the Gospel

The Restoration of God is a gracious reality

item.title: Lesson 04 - Romans 3:1-20 - Sharon Rice
item.description:
Lesson 4: No One Righteous

Romans 3 v1-20

1. The righteousness of God is upheld, v1-8

God's righteousness stands up to human scrutiny.

2. The unrighteousness of man is indisputable, v9-18

All of mankind is unrighteous, living under sin's influence and consequences.

3. Unrighteous man is accountable to the righteous God, v19-20

item.title: Lesson 05 - Romans 3:21-26 - Jonny Rice
item.description:
THE RIGHTEOUSNESS OF GOD IS A PERSON

- The solution 
- The signs
- The Saviour

The method of Salvation has never changed

THE RIGHTEOUSNESS OF GOD IS BY GRACE

- No merit
- No credit
- No returns

The cost of Salvation has already been paid

THE RIGHTEOUSNESS OF GOD IS OUR COVERING

- The perfect made sin
- The temporary made permanent
- The sinful made righteous

The result of Salvation can never be undone

item.title: Lesson 06 - Romans 3:27-31 - Debbie McCombe
item.description:
WHERE IS BOASTING?
Justification by faith leaves no room for boasting - our acceptance rests in Christ alone.

IS HE THE GOD OF THE JEWS ONLY?
There is one God who justifies all people by the same faith - grace destroys spiritual elitism

DO WE THEN VOID THE LAW THROUGH FAITH
Faith honours the law through Christ's fulfillment - transforming obedience from obligation to gratitude

item.title: Lesson 07 - Romans 4 - Sharon Rice
item.description:
Lesson 7: Justification by Faith, Part 2

Romans 4

1. What Paul says

Believers are justified, declared righteous by God through faith in Jesus.

2. What Paul teaches

Justification is available by faith to all who believe.

God's act of justifying covers all sin.

3. What it means for you and me.

item.title: Lesson 08 - Romans 5:1-11 - Jonny Rice
item.description:
1. PRIVILEGES OF JUSTIFICATION

- Peace with God
- Access by faith
- Hope in glory
- Joy in suffering

> Faith in Christ impacts our perspective on circumstances.

2. PARADOX OF JUSTIFICATION
- No strength
- No goodness
- No love

> Faith in Christ transforms our prospects for eternity.

3. THE PLEASURE OF JUSTIFICATION

> Faith in Christ secures our peace throughout time.
